caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark brown ceramic pitcher situated centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher has a glossy surface that reflects light, highlighting its smooth, curved form and bulbous body that narrows toward the neck before flaring out at the lip. The upper portion of the pitcher, just below the rim, features a subtle decorative motif that resembles a small cluster of leaves or flowers. The handle is thick and gracefully curves from the top to the midsection of the body. There are distinct, bright reflections on the pitcher, particularly along the front and left side, indicating a shiny, glazed finish. The shaded areas and highlights emphasize the rounded, three-dimensional appearance of the vessel. The background is plain with faint, irregular patches of a slightly darker beige, providing minimal distraction from the central object. At the lower right corner, there is a signature in dark ink.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
